issues.problem: unit values 二週間 / 二か月 ('every two weeks/months') gave odd rates with 二回/二度 ('twice every two weeks' = once a week).
issues.action: Replaced with 年 / 一年 ('a year').

issues.problem: act 部屋を掃除します ('cleans the room') read oddly with yearly units ('cleans the room once a year').
issues.action: Replaced with 美術館に/へ行きます ('goes to the art museum').

issues.problem: English 'has been getting' + bare adjective was unnatural ('has been getting quiet/famous').
issues.action: English changed to 'has started to become'.

issues.problem: English 'should become' read as a wish/obligation with 危険 ('should become dangerous').
issues.action: English changed to 'is expected to become'.

issues.problem: verb しませんでした: negative にする without contrastive は (ビールにしませんでした) is unnatural; ビールにはしませんでした would be expected.
issues.action: Replaced with するつもりです ('is going to have').
